title: 第二十一章 休整日第二十二章 照常送餐
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 日落西山，星澜宗渐渐安静下来。
杨卤盘腿坐在自己的小厢房里，双手撑着膝盖，一脸纠结地盯着眼前半透明的系统面板。
这三个月，他每天送早餐，雷打不动，风雨无阻，硬生生攒了一万多点许愿值。。
距离一百万，还差九十八万七千。
但杨卤现在担心的不是许愿值，而是明天的八强赛。
他盯着系统面板看了好一会儿，终于忍不住在心里开口了：
“系统，我想跟你商量个事儿。”
【请说】
“明天的比赛，能不能稍微放宽点限制？”
【系统规则不可随意更改】
“我知道不可随意更改，但咱这不是特殊情况嘛！”杨卤搓了搓手，语气带着讨好的意味，“你看啊，八强里面有林浩，那可是三星灵尊入灵境！我一个二星灵王入灵境，跟他差了一个大境界呢！你要压制我的实力到二星灵王入灵境，那我怎么打？”
【宿主拥有五星灵帝大圆满的肉身强度，即便压制星力，仅凭肉身力量在同境界中已堪称无敌】
“肉身力量是无敌没错，但我修炼的是术法方向啊！”杨卤一脸苦逼，“你也知道，我练的都是大观八卦阵、星辕鼎、葫芦散这种高阶术法，肉体战斗我根本不擅长！我要是没收住力，一拳把人打死了怎么办？那可是三星灵尊，不是路边的大白菜！打死了我怎么跟星澜宗交代？任务还做不做了？”
系统沉默了一会儿。
杨卤见它有反应，赶紧继续加码：“而且林浩那小子可是明年内定的圣子，宗门头号天才！我要是在擂台上把他打死了，别说完成任务了，我估计连星澜宗的门都出不去！到时候直接被吕天明带着全宗追杀，我还怎么攒许愿值？怎么复活徐云？要不我直接宣布我是黔灵峰主？”
一提到徐云，系统似乎有了反应。面板上的文字闪烁了一下，出现了一瞬间的乱码，然后又恢复正常。
【……宿主所言，有一定道理】
杨卤眼睛一亮：“对对对！所以我求你稍微放宽一点点，比如让我能发挥出二星灵王圆满的实力？就比现在高两个小境界，总不过分吧？”
【不行】
“那二星灵王半灵境？”
【不行】
“那……那总得给我点回旋余地吧？要是真打出了人命，后果很严重的！”
系统又沉默了。
过了好几息，面板上才缓缓浮现出一行新的文字——
【规则调整：允许宿主在战斗中发挥肉身力量至二星灵王大圆满上限，星力修为仍维持二星灵王入灵境压制】
【警告：若违规使用超出二星的术法，扣除50000许愿值，连续两次违规清空全部许愿值】
杨卤看着这条新规则，嘴角狠狠抽了抽。
肉身力量上限放开到二星灵王大圆满，但术法依然要压制在入灵境？
这有什么区别？他本来也不敢用术法啊！万一不小心放出一个潮庭海波，整座星澜宗都得被冲没了！
“行吧行吧，总比没有强。”杨卤叹了口气，关掉面板。
反正他本来也没打算用什么高阶术法，纯粹是担心自己没收住力，一拳把林浩打死才来讨价还价的。现在系统好歹允许他放开了肉身力量，控制上会好一点，至少不用担心一拳把人打成肉饼了。
他站起身，活动了一下筋骨，正准备躺下休息，门外突然传来一阵嘈杂声。
“杨卤！杨卤你给我出来！”
“姓杨的，你有种别躲在里面！出来说话！”
杨卤眉头一挑，打开门，就看到院子里站着七八个内门弟子，为首的还是刘万和李成。两人脸色涨红，一副义愤填膺的样子。
“有事？”杨卤靠在门框上，双手抱胸，淡淡问道。
刘万见他出来了，立刻提高声音：“杨卤！你那个赌约，还算不算数？”
“赌约？”杨卤愣了一下，才想起来——他之前立过赌约，只要他拿第一，所有人都得管他叫爷爷。
“当然算数。怎么，你们是想提前叫爷爷？”
content_en:
As the sun sets over the west mountain, Xinglan Sect gradually becomes quiet.
Yang Lu sat cross-legged in his small room, holding his knees with his hands, staring at the translucent system panel in front of him with a troubled expression.
[Wish value: 12000]
In the past three months, he delivered breakfast every day, rain or shine, and managed to save more than 10,000 wish points. .
There is still a gap of 987,000 from one million.
But what Yang Lu is worried about now is not the wish value, but tomorrow's quarterfinals.
He stared at the system panel for a long time, and finally couldn't help but said in his heart:
"System, I want to discuss something with you."
【Please say】
"Can we relax the restrictions a little bit for tomorrow's game?"
[System rules cannot be changed at will]
"I know you can't change it at will, but isn't this a special situation?" Yang Lu rubbed his hands and said in a flattering tone, "Look, there is Lin Hao among the top eight, and he is a three-star spirit king who has entered the spirit realm! I am a two-star spirit king who has entered the spirit realm, and I am a big difference from him! If you want to suppress my strength until the two-star spirit king enters the spirit realm, how can I fight?"
[The host possesses the physical strength of the Great Perfection of the Five-Star Spiritual Emperor. Even if the star power is suppressed, the physical strength alone is invincible in the same realm]
"It's true that the physical strength is invincible, but what I practice is in the direction of magic!" Yang Lu said with a bitter look on his face, "As you know, I practice high-level magic like the Daguan Bagua Formation, Xingyuan Cauldron, and Calabash Powder. I am not good at physical combat at all! What if I lose my strength and beat someone to death with one punch? That is a three-star spiritual master, not a cabbage on the roadside! How can I explain to the Xinglan Sect if I am killed? Is the task still completed?"
The system was silent for a while.
Seeing its reaction, Yang Lu quickly continued to increase the pressure: "Besides, that boy Lin Hao is the chosen Holy Son next year, the number one genius of the sect! If I beat him to death in the ring, let alone complete the task, I probably won't even be able to get out of the Xinglan Sect! Then I will be directly chased by Lu Tianming and the whole sect. How can I save wish points? How can I resurrect Xu Yun? How about I directly declare that I am the master of Qianling Peak?"
When Xu Yun was mentioned, the system seemed to react. The text on the panel flickered for a moment, appeared garbled for a moment, and then returned to normal.
[…What the host said makes sense]
Yang Lu's eyes lit up: "Yes, yes! So I beg you to relax a little, for example, so that I can display the perfect strength of the two-star spirit king? Just two small realms higher than now, it's not too much, right?"
【No】
"What about the two-star spirit king and half-spirit realm?"
【No】
"Then...you have to give me some room to maneuver, right? If someone is killed, the consequences will be serious!"
The system was silent again.
After several breaths, a new line of text slowly appeared on the panel——
[Adjustment of the rules: The host is allowed to exert physical power in battle to the maximum limit of the two-star spirit king's great perfection, and the star power cultivation level still maintains the suppression of the two-star spirit king in the spiritual realm]
[Warning: If you use a spell exceeding two stars in violation of regulations, 50,000 wish points will be deducted. If you violate the rules twice in a row, all wish points will be cleared]
Yang Lu looked at this new rule and twitched the corners of his mouth.
The upper limit of the physical body's power is relaxed to the perfection of the two-star spiritual king, but the magic is still suppressed in the spirit realm?
What's the difference? He didn't dare to use magic in the first place! If a tide wave is accidentally released, the entire Xinglan Sect will be washed away!
"Okay, okay, it's better than nothing." Yang Lu sighed and turned off the panel.
Anyway, he didn't plan to use any high-level magic. He just came to bargain because he was worried that he wouldn't be able to hold back his strength and beat Lin Hao to death with one punch. Now that the system allowed him to let go of his physical strength, his control would be better, and at least he wouldn't have to worry about beating people into pieces with one punch.
He stood up, stretched his muscles, and was about to lie down to rest when there was a sudden noise outside the door.
"Yang Lu! Yang Lu, come out!"
"Young man named Yang, you have the guts to hide in there! Come out and speak!"
Yang Lu raised his eyebrows, opened the door, and saw seven or eight inner disciples standing in the courtyard, led by Liu Wan and Li Cheng. Their faces turned red and they looked filled with indignation.
"Is something wrong?" Yang Lu leaned against the door frame, folded his arms and asked calmly.
When Liu Wan saw him coming out, he immediately raised his voice: "Yang Lu! Does your bet still count?"
"Bet?" Yang Lu was stunned for a moment before he remembered - he had made a bet before. As long as he won the first place, everyone would call him grandpa.
"Of course it counts. What, do you want to call grandpa in advance?"
